px_scale_note: texture px x px_scale = design px

layers.note: authored 1280 x 260; stretch to the pad-strip rectangle

floor_grid.note: x on the far wall base line; a floor line through far_x at screen row y is at x = vp_x + (far_x - vp_x) * (y - vp_y) / (far_y - vp_y)

passage_frame.note: ward door frame, centre pivot, 640 x 360 design px: scale 2x to span the 1280 x 720 frame; the arched opening (300 wide, apex y 36) is transparent

stage.pieces_note: pos/size = top-left rectangle in design px; pivot (rotate/sway/flicker) is in design px relative to pos; blend add = draw additively

floor_grid.note: x on the far wall base line; a floor line through far_x at screen row y is at x = vp_x + (far_x - vp_x) * (y - vp_y) / (far_y - vp_y)
x on the far wall base line; a floor line through far_x at screen row y is at x = vp_x + (far_x - vp_x) * (y - vp_y) / (far_y - vp_y)
x on the far wall base line; a floor line through far_x at screen row y is at x = vp_x + (far_x - vp_x) * (y - vp_y) / (far_y - vp_y)

fluoro_wash.note: cold mint-white wash, full screen at px_scale 4; fade its alpha

tunnel_vignette.note: a soft dark tunnel; scale it down from 2x to 1x about its centre to close in

cell_door.note: closed ward door, frame + leaf; 320 x 440 design px at px_scale 0.5 (drawn at 1x it stands 440 px tall, its foot at anchors.door_centre), pivot bottom centre

cell_door_frame.note: the frame only, transparent opening, same footprint as cell_door

cell_door_leaf.note: the door leaf alone, 188 x 378 design px; pivot at the hinge foot (bottom-left) so it can be scaled in x to swing

cell_door_open.note: the leaf swung open (foreshortened), hinge-foot pivot at the left; place at the frame's left jamb foot

flicker_tube.note: a fluorescent tube in its housing; flicker its alpha

interlude.note: cell_door is a friendly ward door (pastel frame, porthole, paper stars): swing it open (cell_door_leaf scaled in x, or cell_door_open) to reveal the day room
